It explicitly asks the reader to 'claim this bounty and negotiate timeline before beginning work' and to build/host the product on a separate dedicated webpage. There is no product source, manifest, lockfile, CI workflow, or test suite to change or to reproduce a defect against. There are no open pull requests (PR count 0) and only the 'main' branch exists, so there is no repository-level engineering task and no competing PR. This is a grant/proposal-style bounty for external product development (a generic product idea without a repository change), which is out of scope for a code-change delivery, so no fix branch, plan, or pull request is produced and the checkout is left unchanged.
